up: Retrieve the ChEMBL identifiers (molecule_chembl_id) and canonical SMILES (canonical_smiles) of distinct compounds tested in assays targeting 'lethal malignant brain tumor-like protein 1' in Homo sapiens. Return only the requested columns. Do not apply any row limits or ranking.
sql:

    md.chembl_id,
    cs.canonical_smiles

JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molecule_chembl_id = md.molecule_chembl_id

    AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens';
